translations.u225: The provisions of this article apply, save as otherwise provided in these General Terms and Conditions, in the Specific Terms and Conditions or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, to all transactions concluded through Fleequid, regardless of the applicable Sales Model. In the context of the Commission Sale they also apply, in so far as compatible, both where Fleequid proceeds by means of Resale and where it acts as a Pure Intermediary pursuant to Art. 2.6. The special provisions laid down in Arts. 13, 17, 18 and 22 remain unaffected and prevail over the provisions of this article in respect of the matters specifically governed by them.
translations.u226: Following full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 and the commencement of the performance phase of the transaction, Fleequid issues to the Buyer the tax documents for which it is responsible, depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance. This paragraph governs all invoices and other tax documents issued by Fleequid to the Buyer, including, where the Sales Model so requires, the invoice relating to the Vehicle, in addition to those relating to the Commissions, the Fees and the Services, as well as the related corrections, credit notes and reissues. In particular: a) in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, Fleequid issues to the Buyer the invoice relating to the sale of the Vehicle, showing the Sale Price to the Buyer as well as the Commissions, the Fees, any reimbursement of expenses and VAT where due; the Seller's independent invoicing obligations towards Fleequid provided for in Art. 17.5 remain unaffected; b) where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, Fleequid issues only the tax documents relating to the Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts due to it, while the invoice relating to the sale of the Vehicle is issued by the Seller to the Buyer in accordance with Art. 17.11; c) in Dealer Sales, Fleequid issues to the Buyer the invoice relating to the Sale Price to the Buyer, the Fees, any reimbursement of expenses and the further applicable amounts, in addition to VAT where due; the invoicing relationship between the Seller and Fleequid governed by Art. 18.4 remains separate and independent. The tax documents issued to the Buyer represent and break down, according to the structure of the specific transaction, the sums already due under the Binding Agreement and neither constitute an independent source of the obligation nor alter its amount, save for clerical errors, corrections required for tax purposes or the provisions applicable in the event of Cancellation or reduction of the subject matter of the sale. Where, as a result of the Cancellation of the Sale, the reduction of its subject matter or the correction of the transaction, or for any other reason provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, it becomes necessary to issue a credit note or a reversal or correction document, or to reissue the invoice, Fleequid shall do so within the time limits laid down by the applicable legislation and in coordination with the restitutionary obligations referred to in Art. 15. Any deferral of the issue of the invoice or of other tax documents for administrative or tax reasons or for reasons connected with the involvement of a Financier neither suspends nor defers the Buyer's payment obligations, which arise and fall due in accordance with Arts. 10, 11 and 12. Where, under the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions, the Financier acquires the status of Buyer, the invoice relating to the sale of the Vehicle is issued to it; the mere fact that a tax document is made out to a Financier that has not acquired the status of Buyer does not, in itself, entail the replacement of the original Buyer or its release from the obligations undertaken.
translations.u227: Where the conditions for the performance of the transaction are met, the Seller shall, within 5 (five) days from Fleequid's request, carry out all the activities for which it is responsible that are necessary for the transfer of ownership of the Vehicle depending on the applicable Sales Model and method of performance, and shall send to Fleequid, to the Buyer or to such other person as Fleequid may indicate the registration plates, the documents and all the information necessary for the registration of the Vehicle in the holder's name or its transfer and for the cancellation of any Encumbrances. For Vehicles already registered in Italy, the Seller shall cooperate and complete the formalities necessary for the transfer to be carried out, where applicable, under the regime provided for by the legislation in force for transfers in favour of professional operators in the sector, including the so-called “mini-transfer”. For Vehicles not registered in Italy, the Seller shall, where necessary, de-register the Vehicle in the country of origin and complete any other formality for which it is responsible that is necessary to allow the transfer, registration in the holder's name and marketability of the Vehicle. The Seller shall also provide, within the same time limit or within such other time limit as Fleequid may reasonably indicate, any further document, declaration, power of attorney or cooperation necessary for the completion of the administrative formalities relating to the specific transaction. Where the formalities for which the Seller is responsible are not completed within the applicable time limit for reasons attributable to it, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, until full performance, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage and to any further remedy provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. Where the same conduct amounts to the unjustified refusal to transfer ownership of the Vehicle governed by Art. 8.11, including as a result of the expiry of the time limit set in the formal notice provided for therein, the penalty provided for therein shall apply in place of the daily penalty referred to in this paragraph; any amounts already accrued by way of daily penalty in respect of the same fact shall be set against the penalty provided for in Art. 8.11 and shall not give rise to duplication. Where, on the other hand, the delay results in the failure to make the Vehicle available or to deliver it, followed by the Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to Art. 16.9, without amounting to the refusal governed by Art. 8.11, the daily penalty provided for in this paragraph remains due for the period already accrued and the penalties provided for in Art. 16.9 are added to it.
translations.u228: Ownership of the Vehicle passes to the Buyer exclusively following full performance of the payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2; in the case of Auctions that moment coincides with the Final Award. The Parties expressly agree that the transfer of title to the Buyer is deferred until that moment, whatever the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance, including the cases in which Fleequid has acquired ownership of the Vehicle at an earlier time pursuant to Art. 18 and the cases in which the sale takes place directly between the Seller and the Buyer where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary. The formalities of registration, transcription, enrolment or registration in the holder's name, and any other formalities that may be required under the applicable legislation, remain unaffected. Once all the documents, information and cooperation necessary pursuant to Art. 16.3 have been received from the Seller, the person responsible for the relevant formality depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance shall, within the following 10 (ten) days, complete the formalities necessary for the registration, transcription or enrolment of the transfer of the Vehicle or its registration in the Buyer's name, unless the applicable legislation, the nature of the transaction or the Specific Terms and Conditions require a different sequence or timing; where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary that time limit applies to the Seller, save for any different time limit provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions by reason of the transaction, the country, the documentation or the nature of the Vehicle. Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the Seller's obligations are therefore divided into two successive phases: a) within the time limit of 5 (five) days provided for in Art. 16.3, the Seller provides the documents, declarations, powers of attorney and cooperation necessary for the commencement of the formalities, with the penalty provided for in the same Art. 16.3 applying in the event of delay; b) within the following 10 (ten) days, running from the moment at which the conditions for doing so are met, the Seller completes the transfer formalities; in the event of delay attributable to the Seller beyond that time limit, the same penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned shall apply, in accordance with the coordination provided for in Art. 16.3 with Arts. 8.11 and 16.9. The penalty relating to the second phase does not accrue for the days for which the penalty relating to the first phase has already accrued. The Buyer acknowledges that the transfer and circulation of the Vehicle may require the completion of registration, transcription or enrolment formalities or similar formalities required by the legislation applicable in the country concerned and that, as a rule, the Vehicle may only be collected after the necessary formalities have been completed. In exceptional cases, for proven operational reasons or at the Buyer's request accepted by Fleequid, Fleequid may authorise the early collection of the Vehicle before the aforementioned formalities have been completed. In such case the Buyer: (i) indemnifies and holds harmless Fleequid, as well as any persons in whose name the Vehicle is still formally registered, against any administrative, fiscal, patrimonial, sanction-related or other consequence deriving from the possession, use or circulation of the Vehicle before the formalities have been completed, save for anything mandatorily attributable to the person relying on the indemnity; (ii) undertakes to take all steps and to provide all cooperation necessary for the formalities of final registration, registration in the holder's name or transfer to be completed within 5 (five) days from the early collection, save where a different time limit is expressly communicated in writing by Fleequid; (iii) undertakes to send Fleequid, within 1 (one) day from the availability of the relevant document or acknowledgement from the competent authority, suitable documentary evidence that the formalities have been completed or filed. In the event of delay attributable to the Buyer beyond the time limit referred to in letter b), the Buyer shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, until the formalities have been completed, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where the delay exceeds 30 (thirty) days, Fleequid may avail itself of the further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions and by law, including, where legally and practically feasible, the right to take before the competent authorities the steps necessary to obtain the registration of the Vehicle in the name of the person obliged, with the related expenses, charges and costs being charged to the latter, without prejudice to the penalties already accrued. In transactions supported by a Financing Solution the sequence of the registration, invoicing, payment, transfer of ownership and delivery formalities may differ from the ordinary sequence in accordance with Art. 22 and the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions, without prejudice to the rule on the transfer of ownership laid down in this paragraph and to the provisions of Art. 22.6; the early completion of documentary or registration formalities in favour of the Financier does not, in itself, entail the transfer of ownership or, in the case of Auctions, the Final Award.
translations.u229: The risk of loss and deterioration of the Vehicle passes to the Buyer at the moment when, after full performance of the payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2, the Vehicle is actually made available to it for collection by means of the notification referred to in Art. 16.6. Where the Vehicle is already available for collection at the time of full payment, ownership and risk pass simultaneously at that time. In the event of early collection authorised pursuant to Art. 16.4, risk passes to the Buyer at the time of actual collection of the Vehicle. Until risk passes to the Buyer, it remains with the person who, depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance, retains possession or physical control of the Vehicle, even where ownership has already passed to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 16.4, in accordance with Arts. 13.9 and 18.6. Once the time limit for collection provided for in Art. 16.7 has expired without the Vehicle being collected, the Buyer shall bear by agreement, to the extent permitted by law, the risks, costs and charges resulting from the failure to collect. Making the Vehicle available for collection does not in itself constitute placing the creditor in default pursuant to Art. 1206 of the Italian Civil Code; this is without prejudice to the right of Fleequid and of the Seller to rely on the statutory rules on creditor's default where it is necessary to produce their specific effects.
translations.u230: Save as otherwise provided in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, in the Specific Terms and Conditions or in any other agreement applicable to the specific transaction, delivery of the Vehicle takes place at the Seller's registered address or at such other location as Fleequid may indicate in the notification of availability for collection, on EXW — Incoterms® 2020 terms, where applicable, without prejudice in any event to the specific rules on the passing of risk laid down in Art. 16.5. The Buyer may collect the Vehicle only following the notification by Fleequid confirming that it has been made available for delivery, unless Fleequid has expressly authorised in writing a different method or timing. The notification of availability is given in the manner provided for in Art. 24, certifies that, as far as Fleequid's own responsibilities are concerned and save for any formalities for which the Buyer is responsible, the Vehicle is available for delivery, and constitutes a formal request to the Buyer to take delivery of it. The Vehicle is normally made available for collection within 30 (thirty) days from full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 or, where the performance of the transaction requires documents, formalities or steps for which the Seller, the Buyer, a Financier or third parties are responsible, as soon as such steps reasonably allow delivery to proceed. The Buyer acknowledges and accepts that the time limits provided for making the Vehicle available and for its delivery are indicative and do not constitute essential time limits pursuant to Art. 1457 of the Italian Civil Code, unless Fleequid has expressly acknowledged in writing that they are essential for the specific transaction; save for such express provision, the use in communications, in the Listing or in the other documents of the transaction of expressions such as “by”, “no later than”, “delivery expected by” or equivalent expressions does not in itself make the time limit indicated essential or peremptory. Save as mandatorily provided for by law and save in the case of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid, Fleequid is not liable for delayed or failed delivery to the extent that it results from events not attributable to it, including, by way of example and not limitation: a) data, documents or information that are missing, inaccurate or provided late by the Buyer, the Seller or other persons involved in the transaction; b) delay, lack of cooperation, unavailability of the Vehicle or other breach on the part of the Seller; c) delays or impediments relating to administrative formalities, registrations, transcriptions, enrolments, cancellations of Encumbrances or formalities before public authorities or registers; d) strikes, interruptions of power or of essential services, natural disasters, measures imposed by public authorities, transport difficulties or interruptions, riots, acts of war or terrorism and other causes of force majeure; e) delays attributable to freight forwarders, carriers, suppliers, subcontractors or other appointed third parties, provided that they do not result from wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid in selecting or managing them; f) in transactions supported by a Financing Solution, delays or impediments depending on the Financier or on the sequence of formalities provided for in the relevant Specific Terms and Conditions. In the aforementioned cases, exceeding the indicative delivery time limits does not entitle the Buyer to any indemnity or compensation from Fleequid, to the extent permitted by law and without prejudice to the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions in the event of a breach attributable to another person.
translations.u231: Following the notification that the Vehicle has been made available for delivery, the Buyer shall collect it within 10 (ten) days, in the manner, at the place and at the times indicated by Fleequid, save where a different time limit is expressly communicated in writing or provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions. Where the aforementioned time limit expires without collection for reasons attributable to the Buyer, the Buyer shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €50.00 (EUR fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle, until actual collection or, if earlier, until the effective date of the Cancellation of the Sale ordered pursuant to this paragraph, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage and to reimbursement of the further costs and expenses caused by the delay, including those of custody, storage, movement, parking, insurance and management of the Vehicle. Where the Vehicle remains at the Seller's premises, the Buyer shall also reimburse the standing, parking and custody costs due to the Seller; where the Vehicle has not been collected within 30 (thirty) days from the notification of availability, from the thirty-first day following such notification, and for as long as the Vehicle remains at the Seller's premises, the Buyer shall pay the Seller, for parking and custody, the amount of €10.00 (EUR ten/00) for each day and for each Vehicle, as the agreed quantification of the cost item provided for in this sentence. The amount due to the Seller under the preceding sentence is distinct, as to legal basis, creditor and starting date, from the penalty due to Fleequid under the second sentence of this paragraph and is in addition to it, without prejudice to the further expenses actually incurred. The aforementioned daily amount of €10.00 (EUR ten/00) absorbs, for the same period, the reimbursement of the same parking and custody item due to the Seller provided for in this paragraph, which may not be claimed twice for the same period; the reimbursement of the separate costs and expenses actually incurred by Fleequid or by third parties and of the other cost items not included in the agreed quantification remains due in full. Where the Vehicle remains at the Seller's premises as a result of failure to collect or late collection attributable to the Buyer, the Seller may not claim from Fleequid any consideration, indemnity, reimbursement or compensation for the Vehicle remaining at its premises, yards or custody areas, the related costs, charges and consequences being borne by the Buyer in accordance with this paragraph, unless they result directly from an act attributable to Fleequid. Where the failure to collect continues for more than 30 (thirty) days from the notification of availability, Fleequid may, by written notice to the Buyer, proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to Art. 14, without prejudice to the penalties already accrued, the Commissions already accrued, where due, and the Fees due, the reimbursement of all costs and expenses incurred and compensation for any further damage. Cancellation ordered pursuant to this paragraph constitutes a case separate from Cancellation for non-payment and does not entail the application of the penalties provided for in Art. 12.9, letters c) and d), or of the minimum threshold provided for in the same paragraph. The restitutionary effects are governed by Art. 15 as follows: a) in Dealer Sales the sale between Fleequid and the Buyer is dissolved, the Vehicle remains at or returns to Fleequid's disposal and Fleequid returns to the Buyer the sums paid by it, net of the amounts lawfully withheld or set off; b) in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale the reinstatement covers both functionally linked transfers, which are unwound: the Vehicle is returned to the Seller, the Seller returns to Fleequid what it has received from Fleequid in relation to the Vehicle and Fleequid returns to the Buyer the sums paid by it, net of the amounts lawfully withheld or set off; c) where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, Fleequid, which is not a party to the sale, remains extraneous to the flow of the price of the Vehicle: the Seller and the Buyer cooperate in the reinstatement, the Vehicle remains with or returns to the Seller and the Seller reimburses the price received directly to the Buyer. As an alternative to the Cancellation of the Sale, Fleequid may continue to keep the Vehicle in custody or have it kept in custody, including with third parties, or take the further measures reasonably necessary for its preservation and management, with the costs, expenses and risks resulting from the delay being borne by the Buyer, to the extent permitted by law. The Buyer's failure to collect the Vehicle does not entail any waiver by Fleequid or by the Seller of the rights arising from the transaction, nor does it suspend or interrupt the accrual of the penalties and of the further amounts provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, save for an express written waiver by Fleequid.
translations.u232: Where, at the time of collection by the Buyer or by the person appointed, the Vehicle is not fit to be moved or transferred owing to defects or deficiencies attributable to the Seller — such as, by way of example, lack of essential fluids, a flat battery, failures of the fuel or braking systems or unsuitable tyres — and the Vehicle has not been expressly classified as non-running, intended for scrapping or subject to similar special conditions, that circumstance is ascertained at the time of collection and, where possible, noted in the delivery report referred to in Art. 16.10. The Seller's obligation to prepare the Vehicle for delivery and collection and to ensure that it is fit to be moved and transferred, the related exceptions and the consequences, including financial consequences, of any breach thereof are governed by Art. 8.14, to which reference is made. The provisions of Art. 8.12 on the custody, preservation, conformity and non-alteration of the Vehicle and the related penalty, which applies to facts and breaches distinct from those provided for in Art. 8.14 and in this paragraph, remain unaffected.
translations.u233: Where, for reasons attributable to the Seller, the Seller delays or fails to make the Vehicle available or to deliver it in breach of the obligations and time limits incumbent on it for the specific transaction, or refuses or fails to complete the formalities for which it is responsible that are necessary to allow its delivery, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale by written notice, without prejudice to the further rights and remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. Fleequid may also, having regard to the seriousness of the breach, restrict, suspend or block the Seller's access to the Marketplace in accordance with Art. 5, without prejudice to the application of the further consequences provided for with regard to User Classification. In the Commission Sale, Cancellation for failure to deliver attributable to the Seller does not extinguish the Commissions payable by the Seller that have already accrued upon successful completion of the transaction pursuant to Art. 12.4, or the Fees relating to the Services already rendered or the other reimbursements and amounts already accrued on a separate basis. In addition to the foregoing, in the event of Cancellation of the Sale for failure to make the Vehicle available or to deliver it attributable to the Seller, in the Commission Sale the Seller shall pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, an amount equal to three times the Commissions payable by the Seller applicable to the specific transaction, as well as a further penalty of €3,000.00 (EUR three thousand/00) for each Vehicle not delivered, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage for the excess portion only; the amount equal to three times the Commissions is due as an independent penalty and does not constitute a further Commission. In Dealer Sales, in the same case of Cancellation of the Sale, the Seller shall pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, an amount equal to three times the Commissions that would have been payable by the Seller had the transaction been structured as a Commission Sale, determined by applying the Fleequid Fee Schedule applicable to the specific transaction and taking by agreement, solely for the purposes of calculating the penalty, the Purchase Price as the value on which to determine the Commissions that would have been payable by the Seller in the Commission Sale, as well as a further penalty of €3,000.00 (EUR three thousand/00) for each Vehicle not delivered, in addition to the Fees, any costs and the further amounts accrued on a separate basis, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage for the excess portion only; the reference to the Commissions is relevant exclusively as an agreed parameter for quantifying the penalty: in Dealer Sales no Commissions accrue or become due and this provision does not alter the classification of Dealer Sales pursuant to Art. 18.1. Mere delay in making the Vehicle available or in delivering it, where not followed by the Cancellation of the Sale, does not give rise to the penalties provided for in the two preceding sentences, without prejudice to compensation for any damage and to the further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, as well as to the penalty referred to in Art. 16.3 where the relevant conditions are independently met. In the event of Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to this paragraph, the penalty referred to in Art. 16.3 that has already accrued remains due and is added to the penalties provided for in this paragraph, in accordance with the same Art. 16.3. Where the failure to deliver also amounts, depending on the applicable Sales Model, to the Seller's refusal to transfer ownership of the Vehicle to Fleequid or, where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, to the refusal or omission of the acts, formalities or cooperation for which the Seller is responsible and which are necessary, under the applicable legislation, for the transfer of title to take effect where this requires further formalities, or for the registration of the Vehicle in the Buyer's name, the specific penalties provided for in Art. 8.11 shall apply in place of those provided for in this paragraph, without prejudice to the criterion laid down in the same Art. 8.11 for determining when such refusal occurs. In respect of the same underlying fact and for the protection of the same interest, the penalties provided for in this paragraph and in Art. 8.11 prevail, in accordance with the criterion referred to in Art. 15.8, over the penalty provided for in Art. 17.8 or, where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, in Art. 17.14, without prejudice to Fleequid's right to rely on the express termination clause provided for therein, to cumulation for distinct facts or breaches and to compensation for any further damage. Where, as a result of the Seller's breach, Fleequid is required to return sums to the Buyer, to bear transport, custody, storage, re-registration or other costs, to pay reimbursements or otherwise to meet claims by the Buyer or by third parties, the Seller shall hold Fleequid harmless and reimburse it in full for whatever is attributable to the Seller, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 8.13. Finally, the provisions of Art. 15 on the return of the sums and of the Vehicle, the reinstatement of the transaction and the cooperation obligations resulting from the Cancellation remain applicable.
translations.u234: Collection of the Vehicle shall take place in accordance with the instructions contained in the notification of availability and with any further indications provided by Fleequid. At the time of delivery a delivery report is drawn up, signed by the person delivering the Vehicle and by the Buyer or the person appointed by the Buyer, which records the condition of the Vehicle, the mileage shown, the documentation and accessories delivered and any observations made at the time of collection. The Buyer may collect the Vehicle in person or through a carrier, employee, collaborator or other person appointed by it; in the latter case the Buyer shall ensure that the person appointed holds any proxy or authorisation required by Fleequid and has been adequately informed and vested with the powers necessary to carry out, on behalf of the Buyer, the checks required at the time of delivery, to make any observations and to sign the delivery report. Fleequid and the Seller may rely on the identity of the person indicated in advance or otherwise presented by the Buyer as authorised to collect the Vehicle and are not required to verify the existence or the extent of the internal relationship of representation between that person and the Buyer, unless circumstances emerge that are manifestly capable of casting doubt on that person's authority. The Buyer hereby ratifies and adopts as its own, in its dealings with Fleequid and with the Seller, the actions of the person indicated or appointed by it for collection, including the statements and notes contained in the delivery report, even where a defect in or limitation of the relevant powers subsequently emerges, save in the case of conduct which falls outside the mandate conferred and is known as such to Fleequid. In transactions supported by a Financing Solution the person entitled to collect the Vehicle and to sign the delivery report is identified in accordance with Art. 22 and the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions.
translations.u235: Where the Buyer requests Fleequid to arrange the transport of the Vehicle to its premises or to such other location as it may indicate and Fleequid accepts such request, the transport is arranged by Fleequid at the risk and expense of the Buyer, save as otherwise expressly agreed in writing or provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions or in the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions, and is subject to the applicable Fees or to a specific quotation. Fleequid is authorised to entrust the performance of the transport, in whole or in part, to carriers, freight forwarders or other third parties identified by it and to choose the transfer methods deemed most appropriate in relation to the Vehicle and the specific transaction. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the mandate conferred on Fleequid relates exclusively to the arrangement and/or physical performance of the collection and transport and does not include any inspection, testing, technical verification or assessment of the conformity of the Vehicle with the Listing, the Technical Specifications, the TrustReport or the documentation relating to the transaction, even where the collection or transport is carried out directly by Fleequid or by persons appointed by it. The Buyer acknowledges and accepts that the transfer of the Vehicle may also take place by the Vehicle being driven by road and that, consequently, at the time of delivery the mileage of the Vehicle may be up to 5,000 (five thousand) km higher than that shown in the Listing, in the Technical Specifications or in the documentation available before the transfer. Such increase, where it results from the transfer of the Vehicle arranged pursuant to this paragraph, does not in itself constitute a non-conformity of the Vehicle or a breach by the Seller or by Fleequid.
translations.u236: The Buyer is in any event obliged to verify, at the time of delivery, that the Vehicle corresponds to what is shown in the Listing, in the Technical Specifications and in the documentation made available for the specific transaction, within the limits of what can physically be verified at the time of collection. In particular, the Buyer shall inspect the Vehicle in order to verify the conformity of the chassis number, the presence of any damage, non-conformities or apparent defects not previously indicated, as well as the presence of the accessories and equipment included in the sale. The non-conformities found shall be specifically noted in the delivery report referred to in Art. 16.10 before delivery of the Vehicle is taken. Taking delivery of the Vehicle without written reservations, or failure to note in the delivery report any non-conformities, damage or defects that are apparent or easily recognisable by means of the ordinary check required at the time of collection, constitutes proof of the unconditional acceptance of the Vehicle with regard to such matters, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 19 on hidden defects and the applicable warranty regime. Where collection is carried out by a carrier or by another person appointed by the Buyer, it is the Buyer's responsibility to give that person the instructions necessary to ensure that the checks provided for in this paragraph are carried out and that any non-conformities, damage, apparent defects or missing items found are noted in the delivery report; the effects of the checks, statements and notes made, as well as of the omissions attributable to the person appointed to collect the Vehicle, are attributed to the Buyer in accordance with Art. 16.10. In Dealer Sales, where the Vehicle is collected from the Seller by a carrier, driver, agent or other person identified by Fleequid, the mere taking of physical delivery of the Vehicle by that person does not constitute acceptance of the Vehicle by Fleequid, or recognition of its conformity with the Technical Specifications, the Listing, the TrustReport or the other elements relating to the Vehicle, and does not entail any waiver of the warranties, remedies or objections available to Fleequid against the Seller; unless Fleequid has conferred in writing a specific power to check and accept the Vehicle, the person appointed by it to collect the Vehicle shall be deemed to be authorised exclusively to take physical delivery of and transport the Vehicle, and the failure by that person to note in the delivery report any faults, defects, damage, missing items or non-conformities may not be relied on against Fleequid as unconditional acceptance and does not entail forfeiture of the rights, warranties or remedies available to Fleequid against the Seller. In the same case Fleequid retains the right to have the Vehicle checked after collection, including at its own premises or at another place of destination, and to assert against the Seller the non-conformities, defects, damage or missing items found, within the time limits and under the rules provided for in Arts. 17.7 and 18.5. The rules laid down for the person appointed by Fleequid do not apply to the carrier or other person appointed by the Buyer, whose actions remain attributed to the Buyer. The noting of a non-conformity, damage, a defect or a missing accessory in the delivery report does not, in itself, constitute a formal complaint or recognition of the relevant objection by Fleequid or by the Seller: in order to preserve any rights it may have in relation to what has been noted, the Buyer shall submit a formal complaint within the time limits and in the manner set out in Art. 20, without prejudice to the liability and warranty regime applicable pursuant to Art. 19 depending on the Sales Model and the method of performance. In transactions supported by a Financing Solution the person entitled to carry out the checks, to sign the delivery report and to submit the complaint is identified in accordance with Art. 22 and the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions.
translations.u237: Where the Vehicle qualifies, under the applicable environmental legislation, as an ELV or otherwise as waste, its marketing, sale, transfer, taking charge, transport and management shall take place in compliance with the applicable environmental legislation and with any requirements, registrations, authorisations and conditions required in relation to the specific transaction. The Seller's information and documentation obligations provided for in Art. 8.3 remain unaffected. Without prejudice to the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions on the custody, availability and transfer of the Vehicle, the obligations and liabilities connected with the possession and physical management of the Vehicle remain with the person who has it at its disposal until it is taken in charge by the person entitled under the applicable environmental legislation; from that moment the obligations and liabilities proper to the person taking it in charge shall apply. The classification of the Vehicle as an ELV or as waste does not, in itself, exclude the application of the Sales Models provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including Dealer Sales, provided that the structure of the specific transaction is compatible with the environmental legislation and with the applicable permits; Fleequid may therefore market Vehicles qualifying as ELVs or as waste according to the Sales Models and the methods of performance provided for in these General Terms and Conditions to the extent that such compatibility exists. Where Fleequid takes part in the transaction without taking physical possession of the waste, any purchase or resale of the Vehicle by Fleequid, including in the context of the Resale or of Dealer Sales, does not in itself entail taking physical possession of the Vehicle or carrying out collection, transport, treatment, recovery or disposal activities. The mere involvement of Fleequid in the transaction, the organisation or management of the Sales Event and the conclusion of the related contracts do not, in themselves, entail Fleequid acquiring the status of producer, holder, carrier or manager of the waste, or carrying out the activities reserved to persons holding the required permits, without prejudice to any qualifications, registrations and authorisations that Fleequid may hold, to the provisions of Art. 16.11 on transport arranged by Fleequid and of Art. 18.8, as well as to the mandatory provisions of law applicable in the country concerned. The activities of collection, transport, treatment, recovery, demolition or disposal of the Vehicle are carried out exclusively by persons meeting the requirements and holding the permits required by the applicable legislation. Fleequid may make participation in the specific Sales Event or the transfer of the Vehicle conditional upon verification that the Bidder, the Buyer, the carrier or the other persons involved hold the necessary authorisations, registrations or qualifications; it may also request at any time the documentation necessary to verify the proper environmental management of the transaction and may suspend, refuse or cancel the marketing or the sale where the documentation requested is not provided or proves incomplete or unreliable, or where circumstances emerge that make the transaction incompatible with the applicable legislation or with the requirements necessary for its performance. The Seller remains responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the information provided on the environmental classification of the Vehicle and indemnifies and holds harmless Fleequid against any claim, sanction, cost, expense, damage or liability arising from the failure to notify, or the inaccurate or late notification of, the Vehicle's nature as an ELV or as waste, from the breach of the environmental obligations attributable to the Seller, from the irregular management of the Vehicle before it is taken in charge by the person entitled or from the delivery of the Vehicle to persons that do not meet the applicable requirements, without prejudice to the further liabilities and remedies provided for in Arts. 8.13 and 20.8. Any more specific provisions laid down in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions for particular categories of ELVs or waste and the rules of Art. 18.8 for Dealer Sales remain unaffected.

u228: undertakes to send Fleequid suitable documentary evidence that the formalities have been completed or filed within 1 (one) day from the availability of the relevant document or acknowledgement from the competent authority → undertakes to send Fleequid, within 1 (one) day from the availability of the relevant document or acknowledgement from the competent authority, suitable documentary evidence that the formalities have been completed or filed — il termine di 1 giorno riguarda l'invio della prova, non il compimento delle formalità: rimossa l'ambiguità sintattica

u231: both functionally linked transfers are reinstated: → the reinstatement covers both functionally linked transfers, which are unwound: — 'ripristino di entrambi i passaggi': 'transfers are reinstated' significava il contrario (passaggi rimessi in vigore); il ripristino è della situazione anteriore (k06: 'reinstatement of the previous situation')

u233: the Seller shall indemnify and reimburse Fleequid in full for whatever is attributable to the Seller → the Seller shall hold Fleequid harmless and reimburse it in full for whatever is attributable to the Seller — 'tenere indenne' = 'hold harmless' (v8 EN 9.6, 10.7)
